rule: PREREG_R8 5.5 / 5.6 = PREREG_R7 5.5 / 5.6 for incumbent episodes: m_F = float64 mean of the finalist's 10 phase-F consensus-B AUCs; m_P_fresh = the incumbent's round-7 phase-F mean (ok, non-flagged runs, >= 8 required, else +inf; never re-run); the finalist replaces the round-7 pick iff (a) 10 ok, non-flagged phase-F runs, (b) own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 8 of them, (c) m_F >= max(m_P_frozen, m_P_fresh) + 0.01 (exact floats). S8 = per episode the result. Trial t is complete iff every episode's job has an ok, non-flagged run t (a round-7 pick kept: its round-7 phase-F run t; a replacement: its round-8 phase-F run t); R8-CLOSEST = the complete trial whose 30-episode mean own-input AUC is closest to the mean over the complete trials (ties: consensus-B distance, then lower t). Never a best-of.
